card.title: Outside the Scope
card.instruction: Redirect personal or dangerous questions by declaring them irrelevant, premature, or assigned to another process.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Why I missed our anniversary dinner belongs in the calendar review.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We're having the replacement dinner now. Explain.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: This booking covers dinner, not the review.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Fine. I'll cancel dessert and we can talk.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we need to resolve the cancellation before opening a second complaint.

mechanism: A excludes a personal explanation from dinner by assigning it to reviews and then prioritizing a new cancellation issue.
confusable: Unlike merely changing topic, A makes process scope and ordering the reason the question cannot be answered now.
comparison: An intimate meal is proceduralized, unlike the window scene's already formal meeting structure.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
